description: List the logged-in user's auto-buy rules: receiver, resource, unit price cap, threshold, budget/order limits, totals bought and active state. Use before `tronsave_update_auto_buy_setting` or `tronsave_delete_auto_buy_setting` to get rule ids. Requires a wallet signature identity. Read-only.
name: tronsave_list_auto_buy_settings
title: Auto-Buy Rules
